Mumbai 26/11 Attack: Anjali Kulthe, a survivor of the Mumbai terror assault, stated on December 16 that Ajmal Kasab showed no remorse despite murdering so many people. Kulthe added, “When I was called to identify Ajmal Kasab, he laughed and said that I identified him correctly and that he was only Ajmal Kasab. Despite killing so many people, there wasn't any remorse on his face. I was saddened and angry by this."
